atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the @tailwind directive to insert Tailwind's base, components, utilities, and variants styles.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use @apply to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Use @config to specify the path to your Tailwind configuration file.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Use @theme to define your project's custom design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, etc.) for Tailwind v4.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Use @source to explicitly specify source files that Tailwind should scan.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Use @variant to define custom CSS pseudo-class variants in Tailwind v4.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Use @custom-variant to define custom variants in Tailwind v4.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Use @utility to create custom utility classes in Tailwind v4.
